question.worked_solution:
The numerator and denominator are $u(x)=9x-3$ and $v(x)=2x,$ respectively. Their derivatives are given by

$$
\begin{aligned}{u}^{′}(x) & =9, \\ {v}^{′}(x) & =2.\end{aligned}
$$

Applying the quotient rule, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}^{′}(x) & =\frac{{u}^{′}(x)\cdot v(x)-u(x)\cdot {v}^{′}(x)}{[v(x)]^{2}} \\  & =\frac{9\cdot 2x-(9x-3)\cdot 2}{{(2x)}^{2}} \\  & =\frac{18x-18x+6}{4{x}^{2}} \\  & =\frac{6}{4{x}^{2}} \\  & =\frac{3}{2{x}^{2}}.\end{aligned}
$$
